notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery and Freed from the Real attached to the same creature.
The creature with Freed from the Real and Elemental Mastery attached has a power of at least two and does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate the creature with Freed from the Real and Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating at least two 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
Activate an Elemental token by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping the creature.
Repeat.
